note: National spirits any focus tree, event or decision can use. No country starts with these; spirits for real starting situations live in per-country files with sources. Values are gameplay estimates.

spirits.name: Endemic corruption
spirits.description: Bribes and kickbacks are part of everyday dealings with the state.

spirits.name: Anti-corruption campaign
spirits.description: Audits, prosecutions and new oversight bodies take on corruption, at the price of friction inside the state.

spirits.name: Brain drain
spirits.description: Engineers, doctors and scientists leave for better pay abroad.

spirits.name: War economy
spirits.description: Industry and the budget are put on a war footing.

spirits.name: Reconstruction effort
spirits.description: A national programme rebuilds housing, power and transport.
